title: Fix WebSocket timeout: set to :infinity to prevent game disconnection
body:
## Summary

The previous `timeout: 120_000` in `player_socket.ex` was still causing AI games to die after ~2 minutes. The cowboy 1.x idle timeout wasn't being properly reset by Phoenix.js heartbeats (30s interval) in this Phoenix 1.2 / cowboy 1.x combination.

**Fix:** `transport :websocket, Phoenix.Transports.WebSocket, timeout: :infinity`

This eliminates the server-side idle timeout entirely. Connection health is still managed by Phoenix.js client-side heartbeat mechanism. Tested locally for 5+ minutes with no disconnection.

Also cleaned up the commented-out `:EXIT` handler code in `Game` module.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/3e78487388ff4d8282e1bc2851ca8275
